note: {gap} re-confirmed at the producer 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor. RFC 9252 Section 5: "Therefore, the ingress PE MUST perform a resolvability check for the SRv6 Service SID before considering the received prefix for the BGP best path computation." The edits to sysRIB.fibEntry (internal/component/sysrib/sysrib.go) since the last judgement are d73a860caf, which turns srv6SIDResolvable and the next-hop resolver into methods on the sysRIB (s.srv6SIDResolvable, s.nextHopResolver) for the process-boundary work, and 13590fe5b2, which renames the caller named in its comment (processCascade to cascadeChanges). The check still runs after both selections and only declines the FIB write, so a route whose SID resolves to nothing still wins the prefix. isSRv6Ineligible (internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rib_bestchange.go) is unchanged and still gates best path on SID extraction and family validity only; no resolvability check exists in internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib. The gap stands; the check before best path is owed by plan/release/fixes/spec-srv6-bestpath-resolvability.md.
